title: CONNECT-UDP Datagram Context Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9298 UDP Proxying HTTP Datagram and Context ID surface.
scope: This verification covers Context ID varint encoding, 62-bit bounds, Context ID zero reservation, UDP payload layout, Context ID allocation parity and request-namespace scoping, reallocation rejection, unknown Context ID drop/buffer policy, empty payloads, Context ID zero payload limits, known-MTU discard decisions, and DATAGRAM Capsule discard policy.
preconditions: RFC 9297 HTTP Datagram support is trace-clean.
RFC 9298 HTTP/3 CONNECT-UDP request policy is trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9298-0002`.
expected_result: The focused datagram Context ID tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 datagram artifacts, generated triage reflects the slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9298 UDP Proxying HTTP Datagram and Context ID surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Live UDP socket lifecycle, forwarding, congestion, ECN, target filtering, and HTTP/1.1 upgrade behavior remain future RFC 9298 slices.
